resources.string: EMMA/MÁVPlusz supplies Volán buses nationwide and BKK vehicles in Budapest. Volán markers are yellow; BKK buses are blue, trolleybuses red and trams yellow.
On by default. Turn off to show Volán routes serving Biatorbágy, Páty and Budaörs, plus BKK within Budapest. Tracking depends on the source; missing positions do not mean a service is cancelled.
EMMA/MÁVPlusz live data is unavailable. Retrying automatically.
EMMA · No fresh tracked vehicles in the selected network.

Volán and BKK vehicle positions come from EMMA/MÁVPlusz. No direct BKK API is used. Only recent source observations are shown; missing tracking does not mean cancellation. Stops and departure boards also come from EMMA. Only departures marked live have source realtime predictions. Vehicles stay visible when zoomed out. Stops appear as small dots; tap a vehicle for its trip details and stops.
